items.title: Zeroday Cloud hacking event awards $320,0000 for 11 zero days
items.description: The Zeroday Cloud hacking competition in London has awarded researchers $320,000 for demonstrating critical remote code execution vulnerabilities in components used in cloud infrastructure. [...]

items.title: Critical Fortinet Flaws Under Active Attack
items.description: Attackers are targeting admin accounts, and once authenticated, exporting device configurations including hashed credentials and other sensitive information.

items.title: France arrests suspect tied to cyberattack on Interior Ministry
items.description: French authorities arrested a 22-year-old suspect on Tuesday for a cyberattack that targeted France's Ministry of the Interior earlier this month. [...]

items.title: In Cybersecurity, Claude Leaves Other LLMs in the Dust
items.description: Anthropic proves that LLMs can be fairly resistant to abuse. Most developers are either incapable of building safer tools, or unwilling to invest in doing so.

items.title: Amazon: Ongoing cryptomining campaign uses hacked AWS accounts
items.description: Amazon's AWS GuardDuty security team is warning of an ongoing crypto-mining campaign that targets its Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) and Elastic Container Service (ECS) using compromised credentials for Identity and Access Management (IAM). [...]

items.title: 'Cellik' Android RAT Leverages Google Play Store
items.description: The remote access Trojan lets an attacker remotely control a victim's phone and can generate malicious apps from inside the Play Store.

items.title: Kimsuky Hackers Attacking Users via Weaponized QR Code to Deliver Malicious Mobile App
items.description: The North Korean state-linked threat group Kimsuky has expanded its attack methods by distributing a dangerous mobile malware through weaponized QR codes, targeting users through sophisticated phishing sites that imitate package delivery services. items.title: WhatsApp device linking abused in account hijacking attacks
items.description: Threat actors are abusing the legitimate device-linking feature to hijack WhatsApp accounts via pairing codes in a campaign dubbed GhostPairing. [...]

items.title: Cisco warns of unpatched AsyncOS zero-day exploited in attacks
items.description: ​Cisco warned customers today of an unpatched, maximum-severity Cisco AsyncOS zero-day actively exploited in attacks targeting Secure Email Gateway (SEG) and Secure Email and Web Manager (SEWM) appliances. [...]

items.title: Operation ForumTrol Known for Exploiting Chrome 0-Day Attacking Users With New Phishing Campaign
items.description: Operation ForumTrol, an advanced persistent threat group, has launched a new targeted phishing campaign against Russian political scientists and researchers. This sophisticated operation continues the group’s pattern of cyberattacks that began in March 2025 with the exploitation of CVE-2025-2783, a zero-day vulnerability in Google Chrome. items.title: SonicWall Fixes Actively Exploited CVE-2025-40602 in SMA 100 Appliances
items.description: SonicWall has rolled out fixes to address a security flaw in Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 100 series appliances that it said has been actively exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2025-40602 (CVSS score: 6.6), concerns a case of local privilege escalation that arises as a result of insufficient authorization in the appliance management console (AMC). items.title: Kimwolf Botnet Hijacks 1.8 Million Android TVs, Launches Large-Scale DDoS Attacks
items.description: A new distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) botnet known as Kimwolf has enlisted a massive army of no less than 1.8 million infected devices comprising Android-based TVs, set-top boxes, and tablets, and may be associated with another botnet known as AISURU, according to findings from QiAnXin XLab. "Kimwolf is a botnet compiled using the NDK [Native Development Kit]," the company said in a report
